probable_root_cause: The downstream dependency catalog-service (/api/catalog/lookup) responded too slowly - 4200 ms initially, then 5100 ms on the retry - consuming the entire 5-second timeout budget (waited 5012 ms), so the search request failed with HTTP 504 after both retry attempts were exhausted.
troubleshooting_steps: Check the health and performance of catalog-service and its /api/catalog/lookup endpoint.
Compare the dependency latency (4200 ms, then 5100 ms) against the 5-second request timeout.
Review the retry policy: attempt 1 of max_attempts 2 already failed with 5100 ms latency.
Consider a circuit breaker or a raised timeout for catalog-service calls if the slowness persists.
expected_resolution: catalog-service latency drops below the 5-second timeout budget, /api/search requests complete within the timeout, and retries succeed instead of returning 504.
